name: Constructive Feedback
goalName: Give constructive feedback to peers' behavior in sprint 1
goal: Feedback is crucial for self improvement, but it is a gray area between emotions and facts. To give constructive feedback is to give the other person something to work with, besides the consequence of their behavior. A very important guideline is to stay with facts, as opinions differ per person. While opinions should not be ignored, facts have more support.

approach.text: <<source Corporate Finance Institute. (2019, November 7). Constructive Feedback. Retrieved November 30, 2021, from https://corporatefinanceinstitute.com/resources/careers/soft-skills/constructive-feedback/>>

normalLearnings: I can give constructive feedback, while focussing on facts rather than my personal opinion.
result: In a retrospective meeting with the group, the feedback given was accurate. My peers found the feedback useful.
contribution: Now the whole group has been given feedback, we can improve our behavior. By doing that, we are more productive and efficient in the future.
